name: dsh-composer-keys
description: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 的聊天输入框自定义发送、换行与打断键位；配置页是 DSH 0.2.x 侧边栏「插件」页上的原生表单（文字配置项 + 微信风格开关，舞台化保存），兼容 0.1.7 与 ≤0.1.6 的设置面，默认保持 DSH 原生行为，忙碌时的排队/转向语义仍由原生「繁忙时 Enter 键行为」设置决定。Customizable send/newline/interrupt key bindings configured on the DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x sidebar Plugins page with a native staged form (text fields + a Chat-style switch); adapts DSH 0.2.x (plus 0.1.7 and ≤0.1.6 settings surfaces). Native behavior is preserved by default; busy queue-vs-steer stays owned by the native Busy-Enter setting.
